description:
Write stories with AI that actually knows how to write. Create your own characters, build your own worlds, and shape stories that adapt to every choice you make.

Long-term memory across thousands of messages. Your story, your control.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

I’ve tried a lot of AI storytelling apps, and Sagaland is the one that keeps me coming back. It strikes the perfect balance between giving you creative freedom and helping you build incredible stories. Whether you’re into romance, fantasy, horror, slice of life, or anything in between, the AI adapts so well to your ideas.

The developers are constantly improving the app, adding new features, listening to feedback, and genuinely caring about the community they’ve built. The new Saga Worlds feature has taken creativity to another level, making it possible to build entire universes instead of jus

Okay, so first, those who were supposed to be grandfathered in with more ink each month for being on the app before the new version didn’t get what we were promised. They don’t add an unlimited ink amount so I spend more money than the Ultra subscription just to get more ink. If it lags, restarts, deletes, or you need to regenerate then it all costs you ink that won’t be refunded to you so you’re just wasting ink on something that isn’t even your fault for happening. If you change the chat, it will still follow the chat before the change instead of what is there so you have to fix that as well

I love love LOVE this app!!! It is so much fun and I spend hours on it without even realizing. The only downside is that you only get 30 ink a day which is equal to 30 messages on your part, which for me is no where close to what I need!! 30 ink lasts me about 10-15 minutes tops, and it leaves me going crazy thinking about the app all day because I want to keep the storyline going but have no ink to! And the only way to get more ink before the refresh time is up is to buy it! There’s no free way to earn more unless you want to wait until the next day when it refreshes your 30 ink. Other than t

Out of all character chatting apps I’ve tried, this one is by far the most intuitive and clearly made for those who want to create a story! Excellent understanding of character, great at building plots! Only downside would be that since it isn’t as popular as other apps, you might not be able to find a character you want to create a story with, but you can create characters.
I think seeing a more in depth version of character creation would be amazing but this blows every other app I’ve tried (polyai, characterAI, honeyAI, etc) out of the water.

I love this app and want to keep using, I pay for the subscription. I wish the search function was better and you could search tags. Also I wish you could edit your story’s title once created because it’s difficult to figure out which branch of the story is which also having character profiles (that you don’t play as, just to help with the prompts) would be amazing too, since there only so much space for the story and I like having multiple and detailed characters. This is probably one of the funnest roleplaying story app I’ve come across. You can make any story you’d like and provide the direction the story goes and the characters too. The app does such a good job getting the other characters likeness as well which makes whatever world you choose to be in more real. There are times the app does mixes up some things or forgets parts of the story but you have the option to rewrite it or just add a reminder. Absolutely recommend this app!

The layout of this app is absolutely phenomenal. Not to mention from what I've seen so far, the bots actually have personality, follow instructions, and are easy to work with.

I also really really like all of the features like adding permanent instructions, being able to be and type as another character in the story..

And just how easy and convenient the tools are to work with.
